motion.name: activity-state
motion.purpose: Activity hover and selection; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: dialog-enter
motion.purpose: Enter from opacity .85 and translateY(6px) scale(.985); disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

shadows.name: dialog-window
shadows.purpose: Soft offset elevation for windowed Modal shells.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:28px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:6px; font:13px/18px var(--font-sans); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button { background:var(--color-accent-fill); color:var(--color-accent-ink); font-weight:500; } .ds-button:enabled:hover { background:var(--color-accent-fill-hover); }

components.name: Ghost button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:28px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:6px; font:13px/18px var(--font-sans); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button { background:transparent; color:var(--color-faint); } .ds-button:enabled:hover { background:var(--color-sel); color:var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:28px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:6px; font:13px/18px var(--font-sans); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button { background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--color-edge); color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-button:enabled:hover { background:var(--color-sel); border-color:var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Overview card
components.description: A compact section of the session overview.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:15px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-edge) 65%,transparent); border-radius:9px; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-panel) 80%,var(--color-canvas)); color:var(--color-ink); font:12px/16px var(--font-sans); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-ink) 3%,transparent); } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:13px; line-height:20px; font-weight:600; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--color-faint); }

components.name: Recent activity navigation
components.description: A conversation-jump row in the overview; the preview is a static specimen.
components.css: .ds-event { min-width:0; max-width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; width:100%; gap:8px; padding:5px 0; text-align:left; background:transparent; border:0; color:var(--color-ink); font:12px/16px var(--font-sans); } .ds-event:hover { color:var(--color-accent-ink); } .ds-event:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-dot { flex:0 0 7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--color-good); } .ds-time { margin-left:auto; color:var(--color-faint); }

components.name: Session search
components.description: Search input above the sidebar roster.
components.css: .ds-session-search { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-width:0; height:30px; padding:4px 26px 4px 9px; border:1px solid var(--color-edge); border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-panel); color:var(--color-ink); font:12px var(--font-sans); } .ds-session-search::placeholder { color:var(--color-placeholder); } .ds-session-search:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Session navigation row
components.description: Three-line selected session row; state icon omitted from this static text specimen.
components.css: .ds-session-row { display:grid; width:100%; min-width:0; min-height:70px; grid-template-columns:16px minmax(0,1fr) auto; grid-template-rows:20px 18px 17px; align-content:center; align-items:baseline; column-gap:7px; padding:7px 8px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; text-align:left; color:var(--color-ink); font:13px/18px var(--font-sans); } .ds-session-row[aria-current="true"] { background:var(--color-sel); } .ds-session-row:not([aria-current="true"]):hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-sel) 50%,transparent); } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:-2px; } .ds-session-row > span { grid-column:2/4; min-width:0; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-meta { font-size:12px; line-height:16px; color:var(--color-ink-2); }

components.name: Session filters
components.description: All and Needs you filters retain a compact selected tint.
components.css: .ds-filter { padding:3px 7px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink-2); font:12px var(--font-sans); } .ds-filter span { margin-left:4px; color:var(--color-faint); } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { color:var(--color-accent-ink); background:var(--color-accent-fill); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Confirmation dialog
components.description: Confirmation specimen of the continuous surface, title and action sizing shared by all windowed dialogs, including rename and session forms. Runtime Modal owns focus trapping and restoration; fullscreen treatment is unchanged.
components.html:
End session?

End this session?

Review the session before continuing.
components.css: .ds-confirm { width:calc(100% - 32px); max-width:480px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-edge) 75%,transparent); border-radius:16px; background:var(--color-panel); color:var(--color-ink); font:13px/18px var(--font-sans); box-shadow:0 24px 64px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / .4),0 8px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / .25); } .ds-confirm-header { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:8px; padding:24px 24px 0; } .ds-confirm-header h2 { min-width:0; margin:0; font-size:18px; line-height:28px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-confirm button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; font:inherit; cursor:pointer; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-confirm button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-confirm button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-confirm button:enabled:hover { background:var(--color-sel); color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-confirm .ds-confirm-close { flex-shrink:0; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; margin-left:auto; border-radius:6px; color:var(--color-faint); } .ds-confirm-copy { padding:16px 24px 24px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-confirm-copy p { margin:0; font-size:14px; line-height:1.55; } .ds-confirm-copy .ds-confirm-detail { margin-top:10px; font-size:13px; color:var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-confirm-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; padding:0 24px 24px; } .ds-confirm-actions button { min-height:36px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; white-space:normal; } .ds-confirm-cancel { margin-right:auto; } .ds-confirm-actions .ds-confirm-danger { background:var(--color-bad); color:var(--color-on-bad); font-weight:500; } .ds-confirm-actions .ds-confirm-danger:enabled:hover { background:var(--color-bad); color:var(--color-on-bad); opacity:.9; } @media(max-width:480px) { .ds-confirm-header { padding:20px 20px 0; } .ds-confirm-copy { padding:14px 20px 24px; } .ds-confirm-actions { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); padding:0 20px 20px; } .ds-confirm-actions button { width:100%; min-height:40px; } .ds-confirm-cancel { margin:0; } }

narrative.overview: Lola uses a compact operational interface: quiet layered surfaces, readable conversation text, and semantic color for state and navigation. This is a scoped source record of the existing desktop system and the optional Midnight extension, not a replacement visual identity.

rules.name: The Theme Choice Rule
rules.body: Add palettes through the shared theme mapping; preserve the default and saved preferences.

rules.name: The Evidence Label Rule
rules.body: Distinguish observed diff totals from agent-reported commands and plans, and retain honest unloaded states.

dos: Do reuse semantic color tokens and shared controls across palettes.
Do keep conversation reading text distinct from compact metadata.
Do retain keyboard navigation and visible focus on activity entries.
donts: Don't present command-run completion as a count of passing test cases.
Don't treat this source record as final visual approval.
